name: Instance-Dependent Nilpotent Obfuscation with Asymptotic Complexity Trap
description: Replaces the globally fixed matrices with instance-dependent matrices that mathematically preserve the exact same 2-coloring compatibility graph (using orthogonal rank-1 perturbations). Adds a Fibonacci scaling factor. This forces LLMs that rely on surface pattern matching to generate code that simulates the matrix multiplications for every edge dynamically. Because the Fibonacci numbers grow exponentially, the large-integer arithmetic causes an unavoidable Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) in their generated Python scripts, while models that genuinely reason will analytically deduce the invariant and solve it in O(N+M) time.
